boundary: Cross-repository routing of an immersive optical/semantic/motion research specimen without changing automation authority or merging the pending canonical repository registry.

owns: semantic material and scene specimen identity

consumers.role: WebGL/GLSL viewer, test harness and visual evidence consumer; cannot amend Shader Grammar operators silently.
Separate Next.js/WebGL experience; consumes current material and design authority through adapters.
Narrative/atlas display consumer, not physical material source-of-truth.
Governed reasoning authority; must not gain GitHub write capability through this routing.

conflicts.description: A shader gallery look conflicts with a physical material mechanism recipe.
conflicts.resolution: Retain visual look as consumer artifact, attach proposed mechanism alternative to shader-grammar review; do not silently rewrite the 13 operator catalog.

conflicts.description: An old numeric render threshold conflicts with a recent measured trace.
conflicts.resolution: Preserve both with environments, timestamps, sources and superseding decision; never replace a measured value without provenance.

conflicts.description: A visual roughness value is requested as an acoustic absorption coefficient.
conflicts.resolution: Reject cross-domain inference unless independent acoustic evidence and units are supplied.

conflicts.description: A product wishes to impose new global motion or repository policy.
conflicts.resolution: Proposal to canonical design or control plane; product may use bounded documented exception meanwhile.

review_gates: Confirm PR #14 canonical registry status; do not insert new registry membership into an unmerged or limited-ten registry.
Require producer/consumer versions, branch/commit identity, validation outputs and evidence class before propagation.
Keep default read-only; approved PRs are needed for mutations in other repositories; never interpret a pointer as permission.
Review performance thresholds on real target devices before promoting candidate budgets to an enforceable quality gate.
Preserve distinct approvals for optical validation, acoustic validation, usability studies and performance traces.
